items.title: Interlocking Star Polygon Islamic Mashrabiya Panel for CNC Cut
items.description: A continuous geometric masterpiece displaying a sharp, multi-axis matrix of traditional Islamic star polygons radiating from a central focal line. This seamless fretwork provides an authentic Mashrabiya effect, perfect for regulating light and airflow.
